sections.Profile:
The Big Show pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing in 1974, is an electro-mechanical game with a circus and carnival theme. Designed by Jim Patla with artwork by Dick White, it features 2 flippers, 1 pop bumper, 2 passive bumpers, 4 standup targets, and slingshots for added action.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Good Times, Carnival, Circus, Clowns, Original Theme, 1970s, Animals, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Dick White
- Design: Jim Patla
